prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: one coherent THREE-CELL horizontal pixel-art sprite atlas, genuinely transparent RGBA background, for animated purple bacteria in the supplied game menu.
Reference image is STYLE AND PALETTE ONLY. Draw NEW COMPLETE sprites from scratch, no cropped fragments from the scene. Do not copy any background, buttons, tissue, blue cells or cyan particles.
Canvas 1536x512, exactly 3 equal 512x512 cells laid out horizontally, no visible cell dividers. Center one full standalone microorganism in each cell, generous transparent padding at least 64 pixels all around. All three fit comfortably and are FULLY VISIBLE, including every membrane spike.
Left: round violet-magenta bacterium, irregular rounded living membrane with short blunt uneven protrusions, simple internal purple organelle clusters, coherent upper-left pink highlight and lower-right violet shadow.
Middle: elongated diagonal rod-shaped purple bacterium, tapered rounded ends, a handful of short membrane hairs, distinct capsule silhouette and simple internal speckles.
Right: smaller round plum-violet bacterium with fewer shorter nubs, lighter magenta center and subtly distinct silhouette.
Design all three as one consistent sprite family: native design around 64x64 pixels enlarged with perfectly sharp nearest-neighbor square pixels, flat 3-4 tone clusters per sprite, 1-native-pixel dark plum outline, vivid purple/fuchsia cells like the reference. Keep the outlines clean and closed, texture sparse, readable at 48-80 pixels on screen. NO smooth shading, antialiasing, blur, photorealism, painted microdetails, cast shadows, glow, limbs, mouths, pupils, eyes or faces. All shape edges must be deliberate pixel stairs. The surrounding pixels must be truly transparent, no checkerboard drawn into the image, no background-colored halos, no typography, no UI, no labels or watermark.
A clean production sprite sheet with three complete isolated purple microorganisms.
export: Aseprite; split equal atlas cells, nearest resize to 128px, alpha threshold 128, preserve generous transparent padding
